title: LAWRENCE MOONEY
tickerText:
ON TOUR NOW!!  GET TICKETS BELOW - LAWRENCE MOONEY IS AN ACCLAIMED STAND-UP COMEDIAN WHO ACROSS A THIRTY YEAR CAREER HAS BEEN REGARDED BY CRITICS AND FANS AS PROPERLY HILARIOUS WHETHER APPEARING AS HIMSELF, ONE OF HIS MANY CHARACTERS, LIVE OR ON THE TELE.

LAWRENCE LOVES PERFORMING LIVE AND HE REGULARLY TOURS THE COUNTRY TO PACKED HOUSES, OVER THE JOURNEY HE’S COLLECTED A FEW NODS AND GONGS. HE HAS BEEN NOMINATED FOR THE BARRY AWARD THREE TIMES (BEST SHOW AT THE MELBOURNE INTERNATIONAL COMEDY FESTIVAL), HE HAS ALSO WON BEST SHOW AT THE SYDNEY COMEDY FESTIVAL, BEST NATIONAL ACT AT THE PERTH COMEDY FESTIVAL AND BEST COMEDY ACT AT THE MELBOURNE FRINGE FESTIVAL.

LAWRENCE’S TELEVISION CREDITS INCLUDE THE HOST OF *DIRTY LAUNDRY LIVE* A SHOW THAT RAN FOR THREE SEASONS ON THE ABC. HE IS A REGULAR ON *THE FRONT BAR* ON SEVEN AND *THE BACK PAGE* ON FOX SPORTS.
